title: Smooth isometric immersions of closed surfaces into Euclidean four-space
summary: Every closed smooth Riemannian surface admits a smooth isometric immersion into Euclidean four-space, without an orientability assumption. This resolves the closed-surface form of the classical four-dimensional isometric-immersion problem.
family_title: Smooth isometric immersions of surfaces into ℝ 4

review.reason: Proves every closed Riemannian surface admits a smooth isometric immersion into R^4.
